ms.report:
Regarding the Comments of POA
・Sorry, I though you saw a Markdown format. We have been sending a lot of POAs lately - I will format them correctly now with this tool. Happy to make the process easier.
・I've requested to turn of the deprecated live code versions.

Now regarding the change request. To not go through the process we have been actively working on:
A) Reporting the original code and links, to match the criteria.
B) Rewriting, in a more modern way the solution. There has not been any change regarding the goals, we wanted just to be transparent about naming and delays. 
The delays are from two major sources.
・Merging with the foundation has been a very long process to get this project to this state to be able to deliver.
・Second, we took some time on updating the core infrastructure to allow using Cardano.
・We originally where syncing thought the CARP indexer, but was expensive for third parties to run an instance. We could of delivered some running example to complete the milestone, but it would not be useful for the community. 
・We started working with UTXORPC to get the standard where we needed, and also supporting Dolos, an implementation of the UTXORPC. This took over more than a year to get all aligned, delivered and in production.
・Then we finally could integrate the UTXORPC standard into EffectStream and make any application possible in a EffectStream dpp.
・Now given all the technological changes over time, we rewrote the templates, documentation, blog, branding and more. 
・And extended this contribution to allow developers to easily develop apps in the Cardano ecosystem locally.

Given this, we did all the possible to deliver the original evidence, plus the new version that actually delivers quality software, standard and integrations for the Cardano Community and has technically implemented this milestone.

Thanks for the feedback.
Brief
This milestone connects projected-NFT detection into the funnel, delivered as the CardanoProjectedNFT primitive in EffectStream, with documentation and a runnable template. The Cardano Primitive observes Lock -> Unlock -> Claim transitions at the Hololocker Plutus script, materialises them through EffectStream's IVM into a queryable PostgreSQL view, and surfaces them to game state machines as first-class Cardano events. This leverages Cardano Stake Pools by implementing a new Primitive with the same structure making the engine reusable to a any Cardano event.

BRIEF
The project delivered NFT projection for Cardano end to end: the Hololocker Plutus contract (lock/unlock/claim), the dApp, the CardanoProjectedNFT primitive reading the script reading the UTxORPC into game state machines, and the projected-nft-preorder template as complete runnable Cardano stack.
